Charleston police say accidental shooting hospitalizes one

You are here:
  1. Home
  2. Local News
  3. Charleston police say accidental shooting…
By Jack Carlson
November 10, 2026 - 8:31 pm
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

CHARLESTON, W.Va. — An investigation is underway in the Capital City into a reported shooting Tuesday night.

Police said a woman walked into a CAMC hospital in Charleston with a wound to her leg at around 7:45 p.m.

She told officers she’d been accidentally shot at a home in the 900 block of Central Avenue, per Charleston police.

“The Charleston Police Department reminds the public that firearms should always be handled with care and treated as if they are loaded,” police said. “Practicing responsible firearm handling and following basic safety precautions can help prevent accidental injuries and tragedies.”
